response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source involvement, Linux experience, and broad full-stack expertise across many domains. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position requiring C1 German (the resume states only basic German), and there is no evidence of formal team leadership, people management, or client-facing consulting responsibility. Python and UML are also absent from the skill set. These gaps against explicit hard requirements outweigh the solid technical foundation.
strengths: 18+ years of hands-on software development across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems
Strong open-source commitment (founder of GISCollective, multiple D-language libraries, FOSS4G speaker) and solid Linux background
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and coding dojos
concerns: German proficiency listed as basic, far below the required C1 minimum
No formal team leadership, technical project management, or executive-level experience
No stated experience with Python, UML, or requirements management for complex client systems

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal leadership/management track record
Strong open-source and Linux engineering background
